fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal affairs, including city commission politics and the prospect of hiring a new city manager; criticism of justice-of-the-peace and court practices involving costs and arrests; discussion of city budgeting and banking service charges on small accounts; civic improvement topics such as cleaning up the Miami River, park facilities (band shell, shade, drinking fountains), and an auditorium/convention hall proposal tied to the Florida East Coast Railway. Also includes local columns ("Miamigrams," "Cap's Column," "Little Geraldine"), business and development notes, a Southern Bell Telephone & Telegraph Company service expansion advertisement, and entertainment/sports notices (including boxing and beauty revue promotions).
